package.description: Find, validate, and serve rotating public HTTP(S) and SOCKS4/5 proxies.

en-US.description: Find, validate, and serve rotating public HTTP(S) and SOCKS4/5 proxies.
en-US.longDescription: Zuli ProxyBroker Extended is a Rust CLI and library that discovers public proxies, validates and classifies them by anonymity, and serves a rotating proxy endpoint, with offline DB-IP country lookup. The executable is `proxybroker`.
en-US.name: Zuli ProxyBroker Extended
